issues.description: Missing `import sys` in numba/cpython/mathimpl.py and numba/np/math/mathimpl.py despite using `sys.version_info`
issues.detail: Both mathimpl files reference `sys.version_info` in the new version guard but the diff only adds `import sys` to typing/mathdecl.py. If `sys` isn't already imported at module top, this raises NameError at import time on Python 3.11+. Verify imports exist or add them; a guard that fails to import is worse than no guard.

issues.description: Version guard targets the wrong Python version and scatters the same fact across four files
issues.detail: `math.exp2` exists since Python 3.9, not 3.11, so the `>= (3, 11)` check is incorrect. The same capability check is also recomputed in mathdecl.py, two mathimpl.py files, and test_mathlib.py. Replace with a single `HAS_EXP2 = hasattr(math, 'exp2')` constant consulted at every site, or drop the guard if numba's minimum is already >= 3.9.

issues.description: `Math_unary` rebinding placed outside class body with broken formatting
issues.detail: The `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` block sits jammed against the class definition, eats the blank line separating it from `Math_atan2`, and mutates class identity as a side effect. Restore the blank line and add a one-line comment explaining why `Math_unary` is re-decorated post-definition, or move registration to a clean block.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. POSIX text files end with a newline; towncrier, RST parsers, and concatenation tools behave better with one. Trivial one-byte fix.

issues.description: Test inputs copy-pasted from `test_exp` with duplicates and no exp2-specific cases
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` repeats `-2`/`2` and never tests `0.0` or integer powers. For exp2, integer arguments (0, 1, 10) give exact known answers (1, 2, 1024) that make regressions obvious. The test mirrors the neighbor instead of expressing what is special about exp2.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch is small, scoped correctly, and follows the existing unary-math-intrinsic registration pattern — but it ships with a likely build-break and avoidable design smells. The blocking concern is missing `import sys` in the two mathimpl files that reference `sys.version_info`. The version guard itself is wrong (`math.exp2` exists since 3.9, not 3.11) and the same capability fact is recomputed in four files, where a single `hasattr(math, 'exp2')` would do. Formatting damage (swallowed blank line, post-class rebinding of `Math_unary`), a missing trailing newline in the release note, and copy-pasted test inputs round out the cleanup list. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK; mergeable after the import fix and version-guard cleanup.
